newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Slovenian couple traverse the globe for NZ birth.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian couple traverse the globe for NZ birth.

text.p: A Slovenian couple travelled the world to have their son born on a New Zealand beach, the New Zealand Herald reported on Tuesday.
The couple, Alenka Vlaj and Tone Koscak, were determined their son would be born in a natural setting.
Koscak, who toured the picturesque Coromandel Peninsula last year, decided on Tucks Bay, where son Maraya was born last month.
Vlaj, who is the personal secretary to Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek, telephoned the premier with the news. Koscak is the prime minister's bodyguard.
"Having a baby is something very special. I didn't want to stay at home and sit in the flat and wait for it, then have it in hospital," Vlaj told the Herald.
The couple leave for their home Ljubljana, the Slovenian capital, on Friday.
